fire: The harsh winter in 1709 froze the canals of Venice for weeks.
A great fire in 1666 destroyed much of the old city of London.

A cholera outbreak in 1854 led John Snow to the Broad Street pump.
The flood in 1927 displaced hundreds of thousands along the Mississippi.
A severe drought in 1936 drove many farmers off the Great Plains.
The earthquake in 1906 left much of San Francisco in ruins.
The famine in 1846 forced many families to leave Ireland for America.
